name: PassRole restricted with StringNotEquals iam:PassedToService (denylist boundary)
note: StringNotEquals iam:PassedToService=lambda.amazonaws.com means the role may be passed to ANY service EXCEPT Lambda. With both lambda:CreateFunction and ec2:RunInstances granted, only the EC2 path exists; the Lambda path is blocked by the negated condition. Verifies that the PassedToService operator (not just its values) is respected: a denylist operator must not be treated as an allowlist.

compound.note: The Lambda path is blocked by StringNotEquals, so the wildcard-resource grant on the CreateLambda statement (index 1) participates in NO compound path and must remain an independent top-level finding. The two wildcard-resource grants on the EC2 path's statements (0 and 2) are subsumed.
